text: Which kit should Bumper (9th roster character, Tank / Normal ram) have?
context: Bumper isn't on the roster sheet (`asset_src/04-character_roaster.png`) but stays as a 9th character. The other eight already cover all 7 weapons, 11 ultimates and 9 passives, so Bumper's kit can follow its own fantasy: a ram that charges in. Renders: `asset_src/characters/bumper/previews/`.

suggestions.text: Impact Blade · Dash or Restoration Field · Tenacity or Adrenal Response
suggestions.detail: A charging melee tank. It shares Cobble's weapon but plays as the Normal-body, faster version.

suggestions.text: Scatter Cannon · Dash or Sentry · Close Quarters or Tenacity
suggestions.detail: A close-range shotgun tank. It shares Plunk's weapon and swaps healing for a Sentry.

suggestions.text: Splash · Restoration Field or Concealment Field · Reinforced Frame or Filtered Circulation
suggestions.detail: A sturdy team-sustain Tank/Helper hybrid that gives Pollen a second Splash user.
